meta.name: incoming-request-advisor
meta.description: Decode an incoming message into a structured breakdown separating the literal ask from the job-to-be-done. Use when a loaded Slack ping, email, mandate, or escalation needs a reply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把收到的消息拆解成字面请求与真实任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为含糊的请求而难以回复
copy.tagline_en: Break down incoming requests into surface asks and real tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clarify ambiguous requests before replying

howto.what: 收到一条待回复的来信时,它会剥开字面请求,找出底下真正要办的事;从身份、权力与利害关系读出对方用意;把硬性要求与成功标准分开,按固定模板输出结构拆解,将猜测列为待验证假设,最后给出下一步动作。
howto.when: 当你把需要回复的来信(Slack 私信、邮件或升级要求)原样贴给它,并表示想先拆解再回时触发;背景不足时它最多会问3个问题再继续。

say.text: VP私信:仪表盘改版能进下个迭代吗?董事会问的。帮我解读再回。
say.note: 会先产出分层拆解,再附回复建议。

say.text: 客户成功经理发我一份怒气冲冲的长邮件,帮我分清楚表面要求和真实目的。
say.note: 会标出对方立场、利害与待验证假设。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a pasted message into a structured breakdown: literal ask vs underlying goal, sender role and stake, must-haves vs success criteria, inferred assumptions, and recommended next steps. Then offers follow-up options.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a loaded Slack ping, email, mandate, or escalation needs decoding before replying. Paste the raw message; if context is missing, it asks up to 3 targeted questions.

say_en.text: VP DM: 'Dashboard revamp next sprint? Board asks.' Read before I reply.
say_en.note: Outputs a layered breakdown, then offers reply options.

say_en.text: Customer-success lead sent an angry email. Separate the surface ask from the real need.
say_en.note: Flags sender stake and assumptions to validate.
